load_saved_model: load a PyTorch model's saved state dict from a file path and apply it to the model
move_tensors_to_cuda: recursively move all PyTorch tensors in a nested dict or list sample to CUDA device
convert_tensors_to_half: recursively convert all FloatTensor tensors in a nested dict or list sample to half precision
query_doc_text_from_sqlite: fetch the raw text of a document by its ID from a SQLite-backed document database
check_paragraph_has_answer: check if a paragraph contains any of the given answers using tokenized exact match
